notes:
Every path below was read from a vendor-owned source: official documentation, or (where a vendor docs site blocked automated fetching) the vendor's own published source code in its public repository. Verification caveats: (1) developers.openai.com/codex/skills and cursor.com help pages returned HTTP 403/partial content to the fetcher, so Codex directories were verified from openai/codex source (codex-rs/ext/skills/src/host_roots.rs and codex-rs/ext/skills/src/lib.rs) and Cursor from its .md docs endpoints; (2) Aider is deliberately OMITTED: no official Aider documentation mentions SKILL.md, and a code search of Aider-AI/aider found no SKILL.md handling, so its skills support is unverified; (3) Continue.dev is included with confidence medium: no Continue docs page documents skills yet, the paths come from Continue's own source (core/config/markdown/loadMarkdownSkills.ts -> .continue/skills workspace+global, plus workspace .claude/skills); (4) Trae's global path differs by edition - the international build uses ~/.trae/skills, the China edition (docs.trae.cn) uses ~/.trae-cn/skills; (5) supportsSymlink is true ONLY where a vendor documents or demonstrably implements symlinked skill folders (Claude Code, Zed, Warp, OpenCode, Qwen Code); false means 'not documented', NOT 'known to be unsupported' (Continue's loader in particular filters readdir entries with isDirectory(), so symlinks there are genuinely not followed); (6) DeepSeek Harness paths were read from the shipped implementation (@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem) inside the DSH Desktop app bundle - vendor source, not a public docs page; (7) OpenAI Codex reads ~/.agents/skills as an additional user root and .agents/skills in each ancestor directory, and its ~/.codex/skills root is marked 'deprecated but kept for backward compatibility' in codex source, so ~/.agents/skills is the forward-looking global root for Codex; (8) Agents whose only documented location is a shared/portable directory (Goose, Zed, Amp, the .agents standard) list that directory as their global/project skills dir, since it is where an installer must place skills for them to be discovered.
